applicabilityBasis.summary: yoUSD at 0x0000000f2eb9f69274678c76222b35eec7588a65 represents a non-rebasing yield-vault share backed by deployed assets. YO identifies USDC as its deposit asset on Base, Ethereum and Arbitrum. The vault-token documentation describes a variable underlying-asset exchange rate, and the withdrawal policy expressly states the exchange rate is not 1:1. These mechanics establish a strategy share rather than an issuer obligation to redeem the share for a fixed amount of monetary value under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the yoUSD vault token separately from its underlying assets, following the existing bbqusdc-steakhouse yield-vault precedent. The contract address matches the tracked token on all three listed EVM deposit chains. Assets are invested in yield-generating pools and withdrawals may require positions to be divested; this is variable share-to-asset redemption rather than a fixed-dollar issuer promise. The opened legal route did not expose usable governing terms, so no legal payment-stablecoin issuer or domicile is assigned. Underlying USDC authorizations, reserves and attestations are not yoUSD-level findings. No securities classification or GENIUS authorization is asserted.
